phase.description: Enforcement phase. See spec/kernel-contract.md §15. pre_merge blocks the merge gate; pre_release blocks the release gate; post_release is monitoring-only and surfaces AssuranceGap.

declared.description: This obligation carries a promise no program can check, and it is declared rather than checked. `owner` is the human accountable for it until `review_on`; `reason` says why nothing can check it. A declared obligation is NOT a checked one: the corpus keeps the two apart so that an uncheckable promise is visible as a number with a name and a date on it, instead of hiding inside the field a checked obligation uses. See decisions/declared-promises-and-three-numbers-2026-11.yaml and tests/fixtures/negative-control-debt.sh.

owner.description: The identity accountable for the promise until it is checked, written or dropped.

review_on.description: The date the promise is looked at again (YYYY-MM-DD). A declared promise is a promise to look at it by a date, and the date passes.

reason.description: One line: why this promise cannot be checked by a program.

obligation_domain.description: Classifier pair (kind + namespace) used by the auto-inference rule and the gate. See spec/kernel-contract.md §8.
